_comment: Values for `npm run prompts`, which renders kit/prompts/*.md into prompts that can be pasted into the routines. Copy to prompt-values.json (gitignored) and edit. Keys are the {{PLACEHOLDER}} names documented in kit/prompts/README.md. Anything left out falls back to the environment variable named beside it below, then to the default. NEVER put EDITOR_API_KEY here — it is a secret and this file sits next to your working copy; the renderer takes it from the environment, and only when you ask for it.
